title: Decision Table — The Stretch the Lateness History Is Read Over on Belrose Promotional Financing Plans
content:
# Decision Table — The Stretch the Lateness History Is Read Over on Belrose Promotional Financing Plans

The run of whole calendar months across which earlier lateness charges on a Belrose Promotional Financing Plan are read depends on the plan's standing and on whether a payment has come back unpaid in the month just ending.

| The plan at the handling date | The stretch |
|---|---|
| Stands past due, **and** a payment has been sent back unpaid on it in the whole month ending on the handling date | Runs **twice** the term's repeat window of whole calendar months back from the handling date |
| Has been billing for fewer whole calendar months than the term's repeat window | Runs back to the date the plan began billing |
| Any other case | Runs the term's repeat window of whole calendar months back from the handling date |

The first row needs both conditions together; a past due plan with no return in that month falls to the second or third row according to how long it has been billing. Twice is a multiple of **2** applied to the term's repeat window.

## The repeat window by term

| Term | 6-Month Deferred Interest | 12-Month Deferred Interest | 18-Month Deferred Interest | 24-Month Equal Payment | 36-Month Equal Payment | 48-Month Bridal Equal Payment |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Repeat window, rolling whole months | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 |

The repeat window stands at 6 whole calendar months on every promotional term, so twice the window is 12 whole calendar months.

## Readings (hypothetical)

| The plan | The stretch |
|---|---|
| Past due, a payment sent back unpaid last month, billing for 20 months | 12 whole calendar months back from the handling date |
| Past due, no return in the month just ending, billing for 20 months | 6 whole calendar months back from the handling date |
| Active, billing for 4 whole calendar months | Back to the date the plan began billing, that is 4 months |
